title: Quotas: nominal shares, borrowing, a lending limit, and reclaim
purpose: Two teams in one cohort, 32 GPUs of nominal quota each. Vision lends at most 24 of its 32; LLM may borrow up to 32. LLM submits eight 8-GPU jobs while vision is idle, then vision submits three.

checks.description: LLM runs 56 GPUs: its 32 plus the 24 vision may lend; the eighth job waits although the fleet has free GPUs
checks.because: borrowingLimit 32 on LLM, lendingLimit 24 on vision: 8 of vision's GPUs stay reserved for vision.

checks.description: vision gets its 24 GPUs at once: one job from its reserved 8, two by reclaiming borrowed GPUs from LLM (InCohortReclamation)
checks.because: reclaimWithinCohort: Any; LLM's usage beyond its nominal 32 was borrowed, so it is what gets preempted.
